metadata.source: ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research) — Fertilizer Recommendations
metadata.notes: Recommended NPK doses in kg/ha. Timing follows Karnataka Agricultural Calendar.

alluvial.timing: N: 50% basal + 25% tillering + 25% panicle. P,K: full basal
alluvial.notes: Use zinc sulphate 25 kg/ha in zinc-deficient soils

black.timing: N: 50% basal + 25% tillering + 25% panicle. P,K: full basal
black.notes: Black soil retains moisture well; avoid waterlogging

laterite.timing: N: 50% basal + 25% tillering + 25% panicle. P,K: full basal

default.timing: N: split 3 doses. P,K: full basal
default.notes: Standard ICAR recommendation for irrigated rice

red.timing: 2 split doses: May and September

alluvial.notes: Sandy coastal soils — apply organic matter

default.notes: Standard coconut recommendation. K is critical

laterite.timing: Split into 2 doses: pre-monsoon (May-Jun) and post-monsoon (Sep-Oct). Apply in basin 1.5m radius
laterite.notes: Per palm: 100g N, 40g P₂O₅, 140g K₂O. Apply 12 kg FYM/palm. Lime 1 kg/palm if pH < 5.5

red.timing: 2 split doses: May-Jun and Sep-Oct
red.notes: Apply neem cake 2 kg/palm + bone meal for P

alluvial.notes: Good drainage essential. Irrigate in summer

default.notes: Karnataka is India's largest arecanut producer. K is critical nutrient

laterite.timing: Split into 3 doses: pre-blossom (Mar), post-blossom (May), and monsoon (Aug-Sep). Ring application around bush
laterite.notes: Arabica: 40-30-40 g/bush NPK. Robusta: 60-40-60 g/bush. Apply FYM 5 t/ha. Shade management critical

red.timing: 3 split doses: Mar, May, Aug-Sep
red.notes: Apply dolomite lime 1 t/ha every 3 years if pH < 5.5

mountain.notes: Shade trees mandatory. Silver oak or dadap recommended

default.notes: Karnataka produces 70% of India's coffee. Coorg, Chikmagalur, Hassan districts

laterite.timing: Split into 2 doses: pre-monsoon (May) and post-monsoon (Sep). Apply in shallow trenches between rows
laterite.notes: Per clump: 15g N, 15g P₂O₅, 30g K₂O. Apply FYM 5 kg/clump. Mulching 15 t/ha essential

red.timing: 2 split doses: May and Sep

mountain.notes: Well-drained forest loam ideal. pH 5.0-6.5 optimal

default.notes: Queen of Spices. Karnataka is major producer. K is most critical

red.timing: N: split into 5-6 equal doses after each leaf harvest. P,K: 2 split doses (Jun and Oct)
red.notes: Sericulture crop. 5-6 harvests/year. Apply FYM 20 t/ha. Irrigate every 8-10 days

alluvial.timing: N: after each harvest. P,K: split 2 doses
alluvial.notes: High N requirement for leaf quality

laterite.timing: N: after each harvest. P,K: split 2 doses
laterite.notes: Higher doses needed in nutrient-poor laterite. Apply lime if pH < 6.0

black.timing: N: after each harvest. P,K: split 2 doses
black.notes: Avoid waterlogging. Raised bed planting in heavy black soils

default.timing: N: split after each harvest (5-6 per year). P,K: split 2 doses
default.notes: Karnataka is India's largest silk producer. High N essential for leaf biomass

kharif.notes: Main cropping season. SW monsoon June-September. Rice in coastal & Malnad. Ragi in southern dry zone.

rabi.notes: NE monsoon supplementary rains. Irrigated crops in northern Karnataka. Jowar rabi in Bijapur, Bagalkot.

summer.notes: Irrigated crops only. Water-stress period. Heat waves April-May in north Karnataka.

perennial.notes: Perennial plantation/horticultural crops. Coffee & cardamom in Malnad/Western Ghats. Arecanut in Shimoga, Uttara Kannada. Mulberry across south Karnataka.

acidic_soil.timing: Apply 2-3 weeks before sowing. Work into top 15 cm of soil
acidic_soil.notes: Raises pH by 0.5-1.0 units. Improves P availability and reduces Al/Mn toxicity

highly_acidic_soil.timing: Apply 1 month before sowing. Also supplies magnesium
highly_acidic_soil.notes: For laterite and forest soils in Western Ghats. Common in coffee/cardamom zones

alkaline_soil.timing: Apply 2 weeks before sowing. Incorporate into soil
alkaline_soil.notes: Reduces soil sodicity. Common in northern Karnataka black soil regions

saline_soil.timing: Apply gypsum + FYM 10 t/ha. Leach with good quality water
saline_soil.notes: Check EC (electrical conductivity). If EC > 4 dS/m, reclamation needed

nitrogen.visual: Older leaves turn pale yellow/green (chlorosis). Stunted growth
nitrogen.ndvi_pattern: NDVI flat/declining during vegetative stage despite adequate water
nitrogen.remedy: Top-dress with Urea (46% N) at 50 kg/ha

phosphorus.visual: Purple/reddish discoloration on leaves. Poor root growth
phosphorus.ndvi_pattern: Slow NDVI increase during early growth stages
phosphorus.remedy: Apply DAP (18-46-0) or SSP. Mycorrhiza inoculation helps

potassium.visual: Leaf margin scorching. Weak stems. Poor fruit quality
potassium.remedy: Apply MOP (Muriate of Potash 60% K₂O) at 50 kg/ha

zinc.visual: Interveinal chlorosis. Small/distorted leaves (khaira disease in rice)
zinc.remedy: ZnSO₄ 25 kg/ha soil application or 0.5% foliar spray

iron.visual: Interveinal chlorosis on young leaves. Yellowing
iron.ndvi_pattern: NDVI decline with yellowing pattern visible
iron.remedy: FeSO₄ 10 kg/ha soil application or 1% foliar spray

boron.visual: Distorted growing points. Hollow stem in cauliflower. Poor fruit set
boron.ndvi_pattern: NDVI plateau despite good vegetative growth
boron.remedy: Borax 10 kg/ha soil or 0.2% boric acid foliar spray
